response.overview: Feng Fei (played by Yang Zhibo) has a congenital right leg disability, dropped out of high school, and has been searching for a job in society. No one can look up to him as a marginalized figure. Until one day he met a beggar (played by Zhang Haining) on the street and seemed to have found some presence. When I went to apply for a job at a pet store again, I met the owner of the pet store, Su Zhen (played by Wei Xinyi), and bought a small lame dog. Su Zhen was moved by Feng Fei's kindness and began to actively contact him. However, Feng Fei, who had always longed for love, withdrew when love really came.
response.title: Ups and downs
